# Golden output cases for internal/isrout (see reference/harness/isrout).
#
#   case NAME INPUT [DEVIATION]   starts a case on INPUT (this directory)
#   arg VALUE                     one fpgrowth argument (rest of the line)
#
# Arguments -v -k -I -h -g are format options: the Go test passes them to
# the Writer. All other arguments are mining options. A case with a
# DEVIATION id expects NAME.go.out, which must differ from NAME.c.out.

# --- item sets, test1.tab ---
case t1-default test1.tab

case t1-abs test1.tab
arg -s-2

case t1-codes test1.tab
arg -v %a %s %S %Q %q %i %x %X

case t1-digits test1.tab
arg -v|%0S|%1S|%2S|%3s|%10s|%12S|%32s|%11x|%99S|%%|%5

case t1-unknown test1.tab
arg -v %b %h %c %y %l %L %123S %.2S %-5S %%%

case t1-sep test1.tab
arg -k,

case t1-sep2 test1.tab
arg -k::
arg -v[%a]

case t1-empty test1.tab
arg -m0
arg -v (%a) %w %W %r %R %z %3W

case t1-eb test1.tab
arg -eb
arg -d0
arg -v %e %E %p %P %3e %12e %0E %a

case t1-closed test1.tab
arg -tc
arg -v %a %S %i

case t1-maximal test1.tab
arg -tm
arg -v (%S) %i

case t1-closed-n test1.tab
arg -tc
arg -n2
arg -v (%a) %i %Q

case t1-gen test1.tab
arg -tg
arg -m2
arg -n3
arg -s20

case t1-dfast test1.tab
arg -s-3
arg -v (%d)

case t3-weights test3.tab
arg -w
arg -v %a %S %Q %s

# --- item sets, other data ---
case r37-pct r37.tab
arg -s1
arg -v %S %s %3S %1S %0S %7S %11S %2s

case r37-abs r37.tab
arg -s-3
arg -v %a %4X %5x %9S

case r37-eb r37.tab
arg -s-2
arg -eb
arg -d-100
arg -v %e %4E %11e

case tiny-thr tiny.tab
arg -s-1
arg -v %s %S %2S %12s %3x %0s

case eighth eighth.tab
arg -s-1
arg -v %S %2S %1S %3s %0S

case names-raw names.tab
arg -s-1
arg -v %a

# --- association rules ---
case t1-rules test1.tab
arg -tr

case t1-rules-abs test1.tab
arg -tr
arg -s-2
arg -c60

case t1-rules-sep test1.tab
arg -tr
arg -k,
arg -I =>

case t1-rules-codes test1.tab
arg -tr
arg -s-1
arg -c0
arg -v %i %a %b %h %s %S %x %X %y %Y %c %C %l %L %e %E %Q %q %w %d %%|%5

case t1-rules-eval test1.tab
arg -tr
arg -el
arg -d0
arg -v %e %E %4e %12e

case r37-rules r37.tab
arg -tr
arg -s5
arg -c30
arg -v %3C %7l %L %11c %0Y %y %2X

case r37-rules-cf r37.tab
arg -tr
arg -s5
arg -c30
arg -ez
arg -d-100
arg -v %e %3E

# --- documented deviations ---
case t1-hdr test1.tab O1
arg -hHDR:

case t1-hdr-empty test1.tab O1
arg -m0
arg -h<
arg -v (%a)

case t1-rules-hdr test1.tab O1
arg -tr
arg -hR:

case t1-dnormal test1.tab B6
arg -m2
arg -s-3
arg -v (%d)

case names-g names.tab O2
arg -s-1
arg -g
arg -v %a
